summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K to announce a board-approved share repurchase and cancellation program. The company will buy back up to 25 million shares (1% of outstanding) for up to ¥100 billion via trust method market purchases from May 18 to August 31, 2026, with cancellation scheduled for September 24, 2026. This buyback is part of a capital policy balancing capital adequacy, growth investment, and shareholder returns, using a total payout ratio of 50% or more as a guide. No advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on EPS and capital ratios.
